title: MZI A short arm: 5 um of the core drawn on Si Slab (2/0) instead of Si (1/0)
evidence: Twin compare route_a_short vs route_b_short (same arm of the two MZIs): route_a_short has Si 2 polygons + 1 'Si Slab' polygon, rv.cell_shapes('route_a_short'): Si [47.4,2.5,58.774,3.0] and [63.774,2.5,192.6,3.0], Si Slab [58.774,2.5,63.774,3.0] (5.0 um long, 0.5 um wide). No other route on the chip uses Si Slab (rv.flat()['Si Slab'] has exactly this one shape). rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,layer2='Si Slab') = 0.97 dB per end, so >= 1.9 dB for the 5 um section (two junctions, plus propagation; in a standard EBeam run 2/0 may not be fabricated at all, then it is a 5 um gap). Extraction counts Si Slab as connected (net N11 layers {'Si':70.1,'Si Slab':2.5}), so LVS does not see it. Picture work/twins/a_short_slab.png
impact: ~2 dB (or more) excess loss in the short arm of MZI A: arm imbalance, reduced extinction, >1 dB on the MZI A path.
fix: Redraw x 58.774..63.774, y 2.5..3.0 on Si 1/0 (merge into one continuous 0.5 um strip).

title: MZI B short arm: 0.5 um gap in the Si core at x=137.149..137.649
evidence: Twin compare route_b_short vs route_a_short: route_b_short has 2 Si polygons [47.4,256.5,137.149,257.0] and [137.649,256.5,192.6,257.0], nothing between them on any layer (rv.query([137.149,256.5,137.649,257.0])). Extraction splits the arm into two one-pin nets N8 (ebeam_y_1550#12.opt2) and N10 (ebeam_y_1550#13.opt3); rv.lvs() design_only contains ['ebeam_y_1550#12.opt2','ebeam_y_1550#13.opt3']. Picture work/twins/b_short_gap.png. Gaussian estimate of a 0.5 um free gap in oxide for the 500x220 mode (w0~0.3 um, zR~0.26 um) plus two Fresnel faces: ~3 dB, with an etalon.
impact: Short arm of MZI B mostly cut: several dB loss in one arm, MZI B extinction and IL lost; a reflection point inside the MZI.
fix: Fill the gap: one continuous 0.5 um Si strip from x=47.4 to 192.6 at y=256.75.

title: Loopback input route (GC4 -> crossing) is shifted +0.15 um off axis at both ends
evidence: Twin compare of the three input routes route_a_in / route_b_in / route_c_in: centre offsets from the port axis are 0.000 / +0.005 / +0.150 um. route_c_in is one rectangle y 507.9..508.4 (rv.cell_shapes('route_c_in')); GC4 pin (0,508) and crossing pin opt2 (115.2,508) are on y=508. rv.cross_section(-0.05,508,0)=(-0.266,0.266) GC taper end, (60,508)=(-0.1,0.4), (115.25,508)=(-0.25,0.25) crossing arm: the route core is 0.15 um off at both junctions. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,offset=0.15)=1.70 dB per junction -> ~3.4 dB on the loopback (estimate, no reflection). Pictures work/twins/c_in_gc_end.png, c_in_x_end.png.
impact: ~3 dB (>1 dB) excess loss on the loopback path GC4->GC5, which is the alignment/reference structure: it corrupts the GC normalisation of both MZIs.

title: MZI A input route (GC0 -> Y-branch) is 0.30 um wide, not 0.50 um
evidence: Twin compare route_a_in vs route_b_in vs route_c_in (same job, same length class): widths 0.30 / 0.50 / 0.50 um. rv.cell_shapes('route_a_in'): one rectangle [0,-0.15,32.6,0.15], area 9.78 = 32.6 x 0.30. rv.cross_section(16,0,0)=0.30 um; ends meet the 0.53 um GC taper end at x=0 and the 0.50 um Y-branch port at x=32.6 with abrupt steps (no taper). rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.3)=0.052 dB per step -> ~0.10 dB plus higher sidewall-scattering loss of a 300 nm strip over 32.6 um. rv.modes(0.3): n_eff 1.83, still guided. Picture work/twins/a_in.png.
impact: ~0.1-0.15 dB extra insertion loss on the MZI A input (each step above the 0.05 dB budget); intent says no width changes.
fix: Redraw route_a_in as a 0.5 um strip, y -0.25..0.25.

title: MZI A output route: 2 um long neck of 0.25 um width in the vertical leg (x=265, y=19.0..21.0)
evidence: Twin compare route_a_out vs route_b_out vs route_c_out vertical legs: B and C are one 0.5 um polygon each; route_a_out has 7 Si polygons, the vertical leg is [264.75,5.0,265.25,19.024] + [264.875,19.024,265.125,21.024] (0.25 um wide, 2.0 um long, centred) + [264.75,21.024,265.25,122.0]. rv.modes(0.25): n_eff 1.60 (barely above oxide 1.444). rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.25)=0.86 dB per step -> ~1.7 dB for the neck (estimate, no reflection). Picture work/twins/a_out_narrow.png.
impact: ~1.7 dB (>1 dB) excess loss on the MZI A output path (Y-branch #7 -> GC1); 0.25 um feature is also near the e-beam min width.
fix: Make the vertical leg one 0.5 um wide strip from y=5.0 to 122.0.

title: MZI B output route uses two 2.0 um radius bends (rule: >= 5 um); twin routes A and C use 5 um
evidence: Twin compare of the output-route bends: route_a_out and route_c_out bends span 5.25 um (R=5, area 3.934 -> arc 7.868 um), route_b_out bends bend__DEGEJ4... span 2.25 um at [260,253.75,262.25,256.0] and [260,381.0,262.25,383.25], area 1.5735 -> centre-line 3.147 um = pi/2 x 2.0, so R=2.0 um. Local mode solves: radiation loss at R=2 is at solver noise (0.9 dB/cm); straight-to-bend mode overlap 0.039 dB per junction at R=2 vs 0.006 dB at R=5 (work/twins/t8.py), i.e. ~0.08 dB per bend, ~0.16 dB for the two bends (vs ~0.02 dB with R=5). Picture work/twins/b_out_bend1.png.
impact: ~0.13 dB excess loss on the MZI B output path (each bend above the 0.05 dB budget); a design-rule (R>=5) violation; more sensitive to width/etch variation.
fix: Re-route route_b_out with 5 um bends (vertical leg at x=265 like route_a_out).

title: GC3 is off the 127 um fibre-array pitch: y=383.0 instead of 381.0 (+2.0 um)
evidence: Twin compare of the 6 grating couplers (same cell, x=0, angle 0 for all): origins y = 0, 127, 254, 383, 508, 635.1 -> pitches 127, 127, 129, 125, 127.1. GC3 pin rv.pin_xy('ebeam_gc_te1550#3.opt1')=(0,383.0); FbrTgt [-24.9,378.5,-15.9,387.5] centred on 383. Intent: one column at 127 um pitch. Gaussian fibre-mode estimate (MFD 10.4 um, w=5.2): aligning the rigid array to GC2+GC3 leaves 1 um on each -> 2 x 0.16 = 0.32 dB; aligning to the other GCs leaves 2 um on GC3 -> 0.64 dB. route_b_out was drawn to the moved GC (ends at y=383).
impact: 0.3-0.6 dB extra coupling loss on MZI B (GC2->GC3) with a 127 um fibre array, and an alignment compromise for the whole column.
fix: Place GC3 at (0, 381.0) and end route_b_out at y=381.

title: Harmless: GC5 is 0.1 um off pitch (y=635.1); route_c_out takes it up with a 0.1 um S-bend of R=5 um
evidence: GC origins: GC5 at y=635.1 vs 635.0 on the 127 um grid. route_c_out has s_bend [198.589,634.75,200.0,635.35]: 0.1 um offset over 1.411 um -> two arcs of R = ((1.411/2)^2+0.05^2)/0.1 = 5.0 um (meets the rule). Fibre offset 0.1 um: exp(-(0.1/5.2)^2) -> 0.002 dB. S-bend mode-mismatch estimate < 0.04 dB (R=5 overlap 0.006 dB per straight-arc junction, ~4x at the arc reversal).
impact: Negligible (< 0.05 dB). Strictly off the 127 um grid by 0.1 um.
fix: Optional: put GC5 at 635.0 and drop the S-bend.

title: Harmless: MZI B input route is 5 nm off axis (centre y=254.005)
evidence: route_b_in rectangle y 253.755..254.255 (rv.cell_shapes('route_b_in')), GC2 and Y-branch #12 pins at y=254.0. rv.junction_loss(0.5,0.5,offset=0.005)=0.0019 dB per junction -> 0.004 dB. Width 0.50 um correct, length 32.6 um same as route_a_in.
impact: 0.004 dB, no effect. Grid snap only.

title: Harmless: crossing placed at 90 deg, so the loopback uses the opt2/opt3 arm pair; LVS reports 4 mismatched nets
evidence: ebeam_crossing4#18 angle=90. Pins: opt (120,503.2) S, opt2 (115.2,508) W, opt3 (124.8,508) E, opt4 (120,512.8) N. Intent: GC4-opt, opt4-GC5, terminators on opt2/opt3; layout: GC4-opt2, opt3-GC5 (route_c_out), terminators on opt and opt4. rv.lvs(): 4 design_only/4 layout_only crossing nets. But opt2-opt3 is a straight-through pair, same as opt-opt4, and the crossing Si is 4-fold symmetric: union of Si vs itself rotated 90 deg, symmetric difference 0.0044 um^2 (vertex rounding), mirror 0.0089 um^2. The two terminators are identical cells placed symmetrically (y 523 and 493, angles -90/+90, routes 10.2 um each, same fingerprint 78479b93794b).
impact: None optically: loopback still goes straight through and the two other arms are terminated. Only the netlist pin names differ from intent.
fix: Optional: update intent_nets.json (or place the crossing at 0 deg) so LVS is clean and real breaks are not masked.

title: Confirm intent-1: MZI A dL = 80.0 um (intent 100.0); MZI B twin is 60.4 um (in tolerance)
evidence: Twin compare route_a_long vs route_b_long: identical cells except the two vertical straights, 34.264 um in A (straight__VLFCST...) vs 24.463 um in B (straight__AF24...). Polygon area/0.5: A long arm 225.201 um, short 145.2 um -> dL_A = 80.00 um (79.94 with ideal pi/2*5 arcs). B long 205.599, short 145.2 (89.749 + 0.5 gap + 54.951) -> dL_B = 60.40 um. dL_A - dL_B = 2 x (34.264 - 24.463) = 19.60 um, intent 40. For dL_A = 100.0 the A vertical legs must be 44.26 um (10.0 um longer each). FSR at 1550 (n_g 4.18): 7.2 nm instead of 5.75 nm.

title: Harmless: MZI B path-length difference is 60.34-60.40 um, inside the 60.0 +-0.5 um tolerance
evidence: route_b_long (polygon area/0.5): 10 + 7.868 + 24.463 + 7.868 + 105.2 + 7.868 + 24.463 + 7.868 + 10 = 205.599 um; route_b_short centre-line 47.4->192.6 = 145.2 um (including its 0.5 um gap, twins-2). dL_B = 60.40 um (60.34 with ideal pi/2*5 arcs). Nominal vertical leg for 60.0 would be ~24.26-24.29 um, the layout has 24.463. FSR change 0.6 % (~0.04 nm at 1550). Same bend cells and same leg layout as MZI A (twin), only the vertical legs differ.
impact: None: within the stated tolerance; MZI B spectrum shifts by a fraction of an FSR, which is not specified.
